tables.steps.SW.help: If your wallet or hardware device cannot sign the setup as one transaction, the review offers Sign in separate steps. The keys are registered first, then the bond, then the request to validate. Each is its own transaction with its own fee, and each stays on chain if a later one fails. A multisig stash and a proxy cannot use it.

tables.manage.ROTATE_RULE: Keep the old node running with the old keys until the dashboard says the new keys are in use. Then stop the old node. Never run both with the same keys.

tables.delegate.MULTISIG_CHANGE_WARNING: Conditions can change between approvals: the minimum bond, the minimum commission or the keys registered to other accounts. The explorer checks the validator rules again when the last approval runs the call, and refuses it if they no longer hold.
tables.delegate.MULTISIG_FEE_NOTE: The signer who approves pays the network fee, and the first approval reserves a refundable deposit from that signer. The multisig review shows both.
tables.delegate.NOT_RECHECKED: Not re-checked by the explorer; the chain decides.
tables.delegate.PROXY_FEE_NOTE: Your proxy account pays the network fee. The change is made for the stash.
tables.delegate.STAKING_PROXY_LIMITS: A Staking proxy cannot send your funds to another account. It cannot register session keys on this runtime: key rotation needs the stash.
